note: Behavioral Health Integration -- Medications for Opioid and Alcohol Use Disorder, OSDH Funding Recipients page (read 2026-10-12). Project: Virtual Substance Use Recovery Program (vSURP). Service Area: 37 rural Oklahoma counties, with 44 physical entry points consisting of seven hospitals and 37 clinics. The 13 primary counties are Blaine, Canadian, Carter, Cleveland, Delaware, Garvin, Johnston, Kingfisher, Le Flore, Logan, McClain, Pontotoc, and Sequoyah, with an additional 24 surrounding rural counties served through the program. Mercy Health Oklahoma Communities will expand its Virtual Substance Use Recovery Program to improve access to treatment for alcohol use disorder in rural communities. Through a telehealth-enabled model, patients will be connected with medication-assisted treatment, behavioral health services, care coordination, and ongoing recovery support closer to home.
